answer: Cheap aliases still pack the voter list when one workshop stamps many keys. To hold a ballot, an identity stakes 38 POA at a lone knoll survey post and hangs a one-use velvet sight-cloth that may be lifted only after two seed-timed nebula plate readings, taken at least 7 hours apart by distinct hill observers. A clone needs its own knoll post and unused cloth. Peers recompute the plate hash from the post log and drop a reused cloth or a crossed observer. A missed plate or two posts sharing a cloth burns 54% of the stake; an observer who double-lifts a cloth in one epoch forfeits 8 POA.
